summary_1line: Vidura returns to Dhritarashtra after meeting the exiled Pandavas, while Duryodhana and his allies secretly plot to attack the Pandavas in the forest.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sanjaya finds Yudhishthira in deer-skin seated among thousands of Brahmanas in the forest, surrounded by his brothers like Indra among the gods.
Dhritarashtra pulls Vidura onto his lap and smells his head in an emotional gesture of apology and reunion.
Karna, eyes blazing and gesturing fiercely, urges Duryodhana and the others to mount their chariots and attack the Pandavas in the forest.
